description: A-EFFort estimates solar-flare probabilities from magnetic-field complexity. It combines an effective connected-field measure with Bayesian probability calculations and returns four flare thresholds for individual active regions and the full solar disk. The resource is documented by Academy of Athens. The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (Flare Scoreboard). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The forecast uses specified solar-disk longitude limits; it is not a direct infrastructure damage model. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
